curation.notes: AFM-based single-molecule force spectroscopy (SMFS) of the Na+-coupled melibiose permease MelB from Salmonella typhimurium reconstituted into E. coli polar-lipid proteoliposomes on mica, unfolded from the membrane with ~13 x 10^6 FD curves recorded across cation (Li/Na/K/Rb) and sugar (melibiose, alpha-NPG) conditions. FD-based AFM imaging (peak-force tapping, Bruker Multimode 8) was used to locate protein-rich membrane patches; SMFS used JPK NanoWizard II / ForceRobot 300 instruments. Constructs include WT MelB-His10, a 42-aa polyGly C-terminal extension and a 15-aa loop-C4 insertion.

hardware.model_number: NanoWizard II / NanoWizard II Ultra / ForceRobot 300 (SMFS); Nanoscope Multimode 8 (imaging)

evidence.snippet: AFM imaging and SMFS were performed at ≈ 25°C using semi-automated/automated AFMs (NanoWizard II/Nano Wizard II Ultra/Force Robot 300, JPK Instruments)

afm.cantilever_model: OMCL-RC800PSA (Olympus) for SMFS; ScanAsyst Fluid+ (Bruker) for imaging

evidence.snippet: 200 μm long silicon nitride cantilevers (OMCL-RC800PSA, Olympus) having nominal spring constants of 0.05 N m−1
For SMFS the AFM stylus was pushed on the localized membrane patches for 0.5 s at a force of 700 pN and then retracted with a velocity of 700 nm s−1.

attachment_chemistry: non-specific tip adsorption to exposed polypeptide

entities.name: Melibiose permease MelB (wild type, C-terminal His10)

evidence.snippet: Contour lengths of WT MelB (485 aa =^ 175 nm; including His10-tag) and MelB polyGly (526 aa =^ 190 nm) polypeptides were calculated assuming a backbone length of 0.36 nm aa−1.
The plasmid pK95 ΔAH/MelBSt/CHis10 containing the sequence for wild-type (WT) MelB of Salmonella typhimurium was used to generate the MelB polyGly constructs.

entities.name: MelB polyGly construct (42-aa C-terminal insertion, His9)

evidence.snippet: Contour lengths of WT MelB (485 aa =^ 175 nm; including His10-tag) and MelB polyGly (526 aa =^ 190 nm) polypeptides were calculated assuming a backbone length of 0.36 nm aa−1.
The final construct pK95 ΔAH/MelBSt/polyGly/CHis9 results in a 42 aa insertion with residue Gly and Thr prior to the 40 aa long polyglycine (polyGly) fragment followed by a His9-tag at the end.

entities.name: MelB elongated loop C4 construct (15-aa SGSG insertion)

evidence.snippet: To construct the MelB with a 15 aa long insertion (SGSGSGSGSGSGSGS) to the cytoplasmic loop C4 (pK95 ΔAH/MelBSt/elongC4/CHis9)

entities.name: E. coli polar lipid extract proteoliposome

evidence.snippet: The reconstitution of purified MelB into proteoliposomes was carried out at a 1:5 (w/w) protein to lipid ratio with E. coli polar lipid extract (Avanti Polar lipids)

components.name: LiCl, NaCl, KCl or RbCl (one per condition)
